blocks.through_line_state: a small amber tube tumbling down the dark tube
blocks.sfx: a gas pump click, a small tumble, a nervous gulp
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes wincing before he has even spoken
CLOSE, low angle: Gut's eyes narrowing in the dark
MEDIUM, high angle: a small glistening amber tube tumbling down past Pipes
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut going completely still

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Gut. Don't be mad.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Why would I be mad?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: We stopped for gas. She went inside.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Pipes. Tell me it wasn't the taquitos.

blocks.through_line_state: the taquito sliding, leaving a shining trail
blocks.sfx: a greasy slide, a slow drip, a tube creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut roaring upward, tube rippling with it
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes flinching as the taquito slides past his face
MEDIUM, high angle: a glistening trail left down the tube wall
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes doing quiet arithmetic

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Those roll under a heat lamp all week.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: This one's been rolling since Tuesday.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Since TUESDAY? Send it back up.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: It's Saturday, Gut. Do the math.

blocks.through_line_state: the taquito lands upright and opens two proud eyes
blocks.sfx: a wet landing, a slow spreading squelch, a proud hum
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the taquito landing upright in the shallow liquid
CLOSE, low angle: two proud eyes opening on the glossy amber surface
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut retreating, brows flat and low
CLOSE on the eyes: the taquito content, the slick spreading behind it

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's glistening. Why is that happening?

turns.speaker: taquito
turns.line: Howdy! Been waiting four days for this!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Four days under a lamp.

turns.speaker: taquito
turns.line: Best days of my life, honestly!

blocks.through_line_state: a slick has spread out around it
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a scrolling flick, a flat beep
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ scrolling fast, expression unchanged
CLOSE, low angle: the phone screen filling HQ's face with pale light
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ lowering the phone very slowly
CLOSE on HQ's eyes reading something it wishes it had not

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, look this thing up. Right now.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: Looking. Okay. There's a review site for it.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: And?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: Two stars. One review just says regret.

blocks.through_line_state: the slick has reached the walls and is climbing
blocks.sfx: a heavy shuffle, a long groan, a door-slam thud
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Liv rising into frame, both lids at half mast
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut pleading, Liv already turning away
MEDIUM, high angle: Liv settling back down heavily
CLOSE on the eyes: Liv closing both, deliberately

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Liv, wake up. I need help.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: Oh, so now y'all remember me.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's a gas station taquito, Liv.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: Nope. That's a you problem. Goodnight.

blocks.through_line_state: the taquito sits calm at the center of everything
blocks.sfx: one low rumble, a distant drip, a slow blink
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel, still and warm and waiting
CLOSE, low angle: Gut looking in, dread arriving
MEDIUM, high angle: Rusty's eyes opening without hurry
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty perfectly calm

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Rusty. Talk to me. How bad is it?

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Cancel whatever she had planned.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She has dinner reservations tonight.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Not anymore. Cancel them.
